summary: Frontend testing of two features: (1) Voice Feedback Export in Reports page and (2) Delete button in TIFMAS roster edit dialog. Both features work as expected.

voice_feedback_export.details: Report Type dropdown contains 'Voice Feedback Export' option. Selecting it displays Status Filter, Priority Filter, and Category Filter (3 additional comboboxes) plus Generate Report button.

tifmas_edit_buttons.details: Found 24 edit buttons with data-testid='edit-personnel-{id}' on /personnel/deployment-tracker/tifmas-rank.

tifmas_delete_in_dialog.details: Clicking edit opens 'Edit TIFMAS Roster Entry' dialog with Delete button (data-testid='delete-entry-in-dialog') visible in footer left, alongside Cancel and Save Changes buttons on the right.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested features verified passing on preview URL. Voice Feedback Export appears at bottom of Report Type dropdown and reveals Status/Priority/Category filters. TIFMAS edit dialog Delete button confirmed visible with correct data-testid.
